operation.source_intent: Render each authoritative SiteUrl as an external navigation link while preserving the displayed URL value.

laravel_runtime.binding: DataTable Sites rows pass row.url into SitesUrlLinkControl.
laravel_runtime.safe_navigation: Only absolute http and https URLs are rendered as anchors; malformed or non-http(s) values remain inert text.
laravel_runtime.display_value: The authoritative trimmed URL string is the visible link text.

security_and_truthfulness.authentication_and_tenant_boundary: The control is rendered only after the existing tenant-scoped Sites workspace successfully reads the active tenant collection.
security_and_truthfulness.authorization: tenant.view and sites.view remain enforced by the existing Sites route and backend contract.
security_and_truthfulness.foreign_tenant: 404 through the existing tenant context boundary.
security_and_truthfulness.network_request_on_click: browser navigation to the authoritative external URL only

deterministic_states.loading: Existing ResourceContent loading state is unchanged.
deterministic_states.empty: Existing authoritative empty state is unchanged.
deterministic_states.invalid_url: The value is shown as inert text rather than converted into an unsafe link.
deterministic_states.valid_url: A real external anchor is rendered with the canonical operation marker.

coverage: exact canonical operation identity and ASP.NET source semantics
authoritative site URL is rendered as the visible external link
no POST, PATCH, DELETE, fetch, or mutation in the link control
